name: Extravagance
overview: Scripture warns against extravagance by highlighting the consequences of loving pleasure and excessive indulgence. Proverbs teaches that those who prioritize pleasure, such as wine and oil, risk poverty, contrasting the wise who store treasures and resources rather than foolishly spending them all. The example of the rich man in Luke, who lived sumptuously clothed in fine garments, serves as a sobering illustration of lavish living that Scripture records without commendation, inviting reflection on the stewardship of God’s blessings.
